create.name: Toby Oliver
create.bio:
Toby Oliver teaches yoga, meditation and deep relaxation in Sheffield under the name TOBY YOGA, working from Eastview Studios on Junction Road. He came to Dru Yoga as a student more than twenty years ago and, after two years of study, qualified as a Dru teacher in 2016. He has since added a 500-hour training in Traditional Yoga, the school founded in India by Dr ALV Kumar, whose meditation follows the eight limbs set out in Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, along with Dru meditation, yoga nidra, Laughter Yoga and Grief Yoga, in which he has helped cover classes for its founder, Paul Denniston.

His sessions mix soft, flowing Dru sequences, breath work and visualisation with stillness and guided rest, and are pitched so that complete beginners can join in, on a mat or in a chair. At present he teaches Dru Yoga as private lessons and for organisations, offers Grief Yoga one to one or to groups, and holds a monthly deep relaxation class live online. He also runs meditation sessions for charities, hospices and workplaces across the UK. With his sister Kate, a psychologist, he wrote Rise and Shine, a book on building a calmer, more purposeful start to each day, which has appeared in Italian, Romanian and Polish.

courses.title: Dru Yoga private lessons
courses.description: One-to-one Dru Yoga in Sheffield: gentle flowing movement, directed breathing and visualisation rooted in the yogic tradition. Toby currently teaches Dru as private lessons and for workplaces rather than open public classes.

courses.title: Grief Yoga sessions
courses.description: Gentle movement, breath and sound used as a way of being with loss, suitable on a chair or a mat and for people who have never done yoga. Offered one to one or as a one-off or regular series for a group or organisation.

courses.title: Traditional Yoga Meditation
courses.description: Breath-focused meditation in the Traditional Yoga lineage of Dr ALV Kumar, following the eight-step path described in Patanjali's Yoga Sutras. Suitable for beginners and for people with some practice; arranged for individuals, groups and workplaces.

courses.title: Deep Relaxation (online yoga nidra class)
courses.description: A monthly live class on Zoom on the last Sunday morning, guiding you through a four-stage method of physical, mental and emotional rest. A replay stays available for a week, and a reduced rate is offered to people on low incomes.
